html:
The Jeep Sunset and Sunrise Tour in Mui Ne by Vietlook Travel is a four hour experience designed for travelers who want to explore the famous sand dunes and coastal scenery in a fun and flexible way.

Traveling by open air jeep allows you to enjoy fresh air, wide open views, and excellent photo opportunities, especially during sunrise or sunset.

Tour Highlights

With Vietlook Travel, this jeep tour includes visits to:

  • White Sand Dunes

  • Red Sand Dunes

  • Fairy Stream

  • Mui Ne Fishing Village

The itinerary may be adjusted slightly depending on weather conditions and traffic, while still ensuring all main highlights are covered.

Sunrise or Sunset Option

Vietlook Travel offers two flexible options:

  • Sunrise Jeep Tour: Early morning departure to enjoy cool weather and sunrise views over the sand dunes

  • Sunset Jeep Tour: Afternoon departure to enjoy warm light and beautiful sunset scenery

Both options are suitable for sightseeing, photography, and relaxation.

Professional Driver and Safe Jeep

All jeep tours are operated by experienced local drivers arranged by Vietlook Travel. Drivers are familiar with the sand dune routes and always prioritize safety and comfort during the trip.
